1.

Thy name, O Father, we praise, Like children taught by grace. Help us in righteousness And joy to stand before Thee!

2.

Sweet the confidence, peace, and joy Thou dost bestow upon our heart. Our spirit now has its refuge In the light where Thou art.

3.

There, in Thy love’s purpose, He A place for us hath prepared, As sons with Him now, He who bore our sorrow here.

4.

Though still here, our hope it is, When the path is fully trod, That He will take us up to Himself Far beyond death’s power.

5.

Holy Father, keep us thus, Within Thy great love, That without fear we may walk here, Until we dwell with Thee.
